title: Paris vs Amsterdam: Which Should You Visit?

faqs.question: Is Paris or Amsterdam better for first-time visitors to Europe?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent first-time European destinations. Paris is the classic European capital with grand architecture, world-class museums, and legendary food. Amsterdam is smaller, easier to navigate, bikeable, and laid-back. Reddit consensus: Paris for grand culture, Amsterdam for relaxed vibes. Many

faqs.question: How far apart are Paris and Amsterdam?
faqs.answer: About 500 km apart. The Thalys/Eurostar high-speed train takes approximately 3 hours 20 minutes and costs 35-120 EUR one way. Budget airlines fly the route in about 1 hour 15 minutes for 30-80 EUR. The train is preferred since both stations (Paris Gare du Nord and Amsterdam Centraal) are central.

faqs.question: Is it worth visiting both Paris and Amsterdam on one trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely, if you have 7+ days. A common split is 4 days Paris + 3 days Amsterdam. The 3h20m Thalys train is comfortable and scenic. Fly into one city and out of the other to avoid backtracking.

faqs.question: Which is cheaper, Paris or Amsterdam?
faqs.answer: Surprisingly similar, but Amsterdam is slightly more expensive overall. Restaurant meals in Amsterdam cost 12-25% more (Numbeo data). A basic meal is about 20 EUR in Amsterdam vs 15 EUR in Paris. Beer is cheaper in Amsterdam; wine is cheaper in Paris. Mid-range daily budgets: 120-180 EUR for Paris,

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Paris vs Amsterdam?
faqs.answer: Minimum 3-4 full days in Paris, 2-3 in Amsterdam. Paris has virtually limitless attractions. Amsterdam highlights can be covered in 2-3 days but you could fill 4-5 with day trips to Haarlem, Zaanse Schans, or Keukenhof.

faqs.question: Can you do a day trip from Paris to Amsterdam?
faqs.answer: Technically possible but not recommended. The 3h20m each way eats nearly 7 hours. Even one overnight in Amsterdam is dramatically better. For a canal-city fix closer to Paris, try Bruges (2.5h by train).

faqs.question: Is Amsterdam safe compared to Paris?
faqs.answer: Both are generally safe for tourists. Amsterdam Red Light District can feel sketchy at night, pickpocketing is common around Centraal Station.
